meanings: Grease is an oily substance put on moving parts so they work smoothly, or oil or fat in cooking.
examples: When I was done working on the car, I had grease all over my hands.

meanings: Knowledge is what you know.
examples: He has trouble putting his knowledge into practice.

words.general_translation_vi: Bỏ sót, bỏ quên, bỏ đi (một từ... )
meanings: When you omit something, you leave it out or do not do it.
examples: I omitted some important information: he is not coming.

words.general_translation_vi: Bù lại, đền bù, bù đắp
meanings: To offset means to use one thing to cancel out the effect of another thing.
examples: Increased wages are offset by higher prices for goods.

meanings: To overlap something means to cover a piece of it.
examples: The gift on top overlaps the other gift on the bottom.

meanings: When something is secondhand , it has been owned by someone else.
examples: Her secondhand jeans were a bit faded in the front.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự khéo léo, sự khéo tay, sự tinh xảo
meanings: When you have skill at doing a job, you are good at doing it.
examples: She worked with great skill and confidence.

words.general_translation_vi: Đường đi của hươu nai, vết đi của hươu nai
meanings: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container.
examples: To operate the machine, put your coins into the slot .

meanings: A tactic is a careful plan to achieve something.
examples: Sam thought of a good tactic to attract more business.

meanings: If something is beneficial , it is good for you.
examples: Drinking milk every day is beneficial for your bones.

meanings: A birthplace is a place where a person is born or where something started.
examples: China is the birthplace of chopsticks.

words.general_translation_vi: Sức chứa, chứa đựng, dung tích
meanings: The capacity of something is the amount of things that can be put in it.
examples: The parking lot has reached its full capacity .

meanings: If something is comparative , it is being judged based on something else.
examples: The money that John has is comparative to that of most other adults.

words.general_translation_vi: Có đầy đủ thông tin một cách toàn diện
meanings: If something is comprehensive , it has all the details about something else.
examples: The teacher gave us a comprehensive review for the exam.

words.general_translation_vi: Giữ gìn, duy trì, bảo tồn, bảo toàn
meanings: To conserve something is to protect it from being ruined or used completely.
examples: The group worked to conserve the beauty of Europe's national parks.

meanings: If something is crucial , it is extremely important to another thing.
examples: Clean air is crucial to the survival of humans, plants, and animals.

words.general_translation_vi: Tích lũy, dồn lại, chồng chất mãi lên
meanings: Cumulative describes an increase by adding one after another.
examples: The cumulative snowfall in the area is fifty centimeters per year.

words.general_translation_vi: Gửi (tiền, đồ vật... ), gửi (tiền) ở ngân hàng
meanings: To deposit something is to put it into a place or another thing.
examples: I deposited the money into my bank account.

words.general_translation_vi: Phân bổ, phân phối, phân phát
meanings: To distribute something is to give it to a number of people.
examples: The teacher distributed crayons and markers to her students.

meanings: He equator is an imaginary line that splits the Earth into north and south.
examples: The equator crosses the northern part of South America.

words.general_translation_vi: Ở nước ngoài đưa vào, ngoại lai (cây cỏ, từ, mốt)
meanings: Exotic describes something unusual because it is from far away.
examples: Rebecca tried many exotic foods on her trip to Africa.

meanings: If something is federal , it relates to the government of a country.
examples: Sometimes federal laws are different from state laws.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự hình thành, sự tạo thành, sự lập nên
meanings: A formation is the way that something is made.
examples: The formation of ice happens when water freezes.

words.general_translation_vi: Tính thường xuyên, tính thường hay xảy ra
meanings: The frequency of something is the number of times that it happens.
examples: The frequency of rainstorms is very high, especially during the spring.

meanings: An objective is a goal or plan that someone has.
examples: My objective this week is to finish my homework by 7:30 every night.

meanings: Oxygen is a gas that all living things need to breathe.
examples: She thinks there is more oxygen in the air in the country than in the city.

meanings: A rainforest is a forest that is in a place where it rains very often.
examples: The rainforest is home to many animals.

meanings: A strategy is a plan for how to do something.
examples: The team came up with a strategy to win the game.

words.general_translation_vi: Có rừng, lắm rừng, có nhiều cây cối
meanings: If an area is wooded , it is covered with trees.
examples: Jim and Ben decided to go hiking in the wooded area by the river.

words.general_translation_vi: Điều có lợi, ích lợi (chỉ dùng trong những kết hợp dưới đây)
meanings: Avail is help or benefit.
examples: His studying was to no avail because he failed the test.

meanings: To define means to clearly state, show, or explain what something is.
examples: People define success in many different ways.

words.general_translation_vi: Kinh sợ, kinh hãi, khiếp sợ
meanings: To dread is to be afraid of something that could, or is going to, happen.
examples: I dread the possibility that I will not get into college.

meanings: To expand is to become bigger in size.
examples: A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.

words.general_translation_vi: Cơ bản, cơ sở, chủ yếu
meanings: If something is fundamental , it is a basic part of something.
examples: The fundamental rules of basketball are easy.

meanings: If something is horrifying , it is frightening and very unpleasant.
examples: There was a horrifying car accident today.

meanings: If someone is incredulous about something, they do not believe that it is true.
examples: She was incredulous that monkeys could ever drive a car.

words.general_translation_vi: Nấn ná, lần lữa, chần chừ, nán lại
meanings: To linger is to last for a long time.
examples: The smell of fresh cookies lingered in the bakery.

meanings: An organism is a living thing, especially a very small one.
examples: We studied the organism under the microscope.

words.general_translation_vi: Diễn tả bằng ngữ giải thích, chú giải dài dòng
meanings: To paraphrase is to make someone else's writing or speech shorter.
examples: The students were asked to paraphrase the story they had just heard.

meanings: A plague is a serious disease that quickly spreads to many people.
examples: A plague in Europe killed millions of people.

words.general_translation_vi: Chẳng mấy chốc, ngay sau đó
meanings: If something happens presently , it is happening right now.
examples: Presently , our profits are good, but by next year we can do even better.

meanings: If something is random , it happens without any pattern or reason.
examples: Young children often ask random questions.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự náo động, sự náo loạn, sự tụ tập phá rối (trật tự công cộng... )
meanings: A riot is a crowd that reacts to bad news by violently breaking laws.
examples: A riot broke out after the candidate lost the election.

words.general_translation_vi: Viết chữ nguệch ngoạc, viết cẩu thả, viết vội vàng
meanings: To scribble is to write something quickly without caring about how it looks.
examples: I scribbled a rough diagram of our plan and gave it to him.

meanings: A shrine is a religious building built to honor a person, event, or god.
examples: He prayed at the shrine for an hour.

meanings: Solitude is the state of being totally alone.
examples: John lives a life of solitude because he doesn't get along well with people.

meanings: If something is stark , then it is severe or clear in appearance or outline.
examples: There is a stark contrast between their test scores.

words.general_translation_vi: Gọi đến, mời đến, triệu đến
meanings: To summon a person is to ask them to come to you.
examples: We summoned the doctor as soon as we noticed she was sick.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm cho xấu hơn, làm cho tồi hơn, làm cho tệ hơn
meanings: To worsen is to get worse.
examples: The weather suddenly worsened , and we had to stay inside.

meanings: An automobile is a car.
examples: The first automobiles were very different from the ones that exist today.

meanings: A candidate is a person who is competing to win something such as a job.
examples: Alice is the best candidate for the job.

meanings: If something is confidential , it must be kept secret.
examples: The information from the meeting is confidential .

meanings: If something is corporate , it is related to a large business.
examples: Tom enjoys working in the corporate world.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm tăng, nâng cao, đề cao, làm nổi bật (đức tính, quyền hạn... )
meanings: To enhance something is to make it better.
examples: Amy's blue shirt really enhances the color of her eyes.

meanings: An era is a period of time that has something special about it.
examples: During the medieval era , knights wore protective armor.

words.general_translation_vi: Nguyên tắc chỉ đạo, đường lối chỉ đạo (để vạch ra chính sách... )
meanings: A guideline is a rule about how to do something.
examples: Before they began the project, the teacher gave them some guidelines .

words.general_translation_vi: Sáp nhập, hợp nhất, kết hợp chặt chẽ
meanings: To incorporate is to add something to another thing.
examples: I decided to incorporate a new ingredient into my cake recipe.

words.general_translation_vi: Ảnh hưởng lẫn nhau, tác động qua lại
meanings: To interact is to talk to or do something with another person.
examples: The kids began to interact when the adults left the room.

words.general_translation_vi: Khoảng (thời gian, không gian), khoảng cách
meanings: An interval is the time between two things happening.
examples: Tony rested for brief intervals while he worked in the yard.

meanings: If something is mobile , it can be moved easily.
examples: Mobile phones are convenient because you can use them anywhere.

words.general_translation_vi: Giảm bớt, làm nhẹ, làm dịu
meanings: To modify something is to change it a little bit.
examples: I modified my outfit by adding a belt to it.

meanings: If two things are parallel , they are the same distance away from each other (along their entire length).
examples: There are two yellow parallel lines dividing both sides of traffic.

meanings: A phenomenon is something that can be seen as it is happening.
examples: I thought the lights were a strange phenomenon , but they were just shooting stars.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm ô uế, làm mất thiêng liêng
meanings: To pollute means to make air, water, or land dirty, unclean, or foul.
examples: The careless factory polluted the river with chemicals.

meanings: To ridicule is to make fun of something in a mean way.
examples: The other students ridicule Peter's foreign accent.

meanings: If something is solar , it is related to the sun.
examples: Using solar energy is good for the environment.

words.general_translation_vi: Đất đai, địa hạt, lãnh thổ
meanings: A territory is a piece of land that belongs to a country but isn't a state.
examples: Gibraltar is a territory of Great Britain.

meanings: A tournament is a competition, usually with many people participating.
examples: My dad is playing in a golf tournament tomorrow.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự chuyên chở, sự vận tải
meanings: Transportation is any type of vehicle that can carry people or things.
examples: I don't have a car, so my normal transportation is the train.

words.general_translation_vi: Cái kéo liềm (để tỉa cành cây trên cao)
meanings: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or for a service.
examples: I have so many bills that I do not know how to pay them all.

meanings: A boundary is the line where one area of land stops and another begins.
examples: This fence shows the boundary between our yard and yours.

words.general_translation_vi: Thời đại hỗn nguyên, thời đại hỗn mang
meanings: Chaos is a situation that is confusing and not ordered.
examples: His presentation was in chaos . I couldn't understand what he meant.

meanings: If a person is consistent , they always have the same behavior or attitude.
examples: Sara comes in every day and is our most consistent worker.

words.general_translation_vi: Khi xoáy thuận, khi xoáy tụ
meanings: A cyclone is a large storm with heavy rain and winds that spin in a circle.
examples: Hundreds of homes were damaged by the cyclone .

meanings: If someone or something is doomed , they are going to fail or be destroyed.
examples: Since I spent all my money, my date with Jane is doomed .

words.general_translation_vi: Người thừa kế, người thừa tự
meanings: An heir is a person who receives the money or property of someone who dies.
examples: The princess was the heir to the king and queen's throne.

meanings: If something is martial , it is related to fighting or war.
examples: Karate is a martial art that began many years ago in Japan.

meanings: If food is organic , it is grown without adding chemicals to it.
examples: The organic carrots are more expensive, but they're better for you.

meanings: Poultry is a bird, such as a chicken, that is used for meat and eggs.
examples: He raises poultry and sells their meat for extra money.

words.general_translation_vi: Bò, toài, trườn (trên đất mấp mô)
meanings: To scramble is to move somewhere quickly and desperately.
examples: The hikers scrambled down the side of the hill.

meanings: A sergeant is a soldier or police officer of middle rank.
examples: He was promoted to sergeant after a year in the army.

meanings: If you describe something as sheer , it is complete and total.
examples: I was impressed by her sheer dedication to jogging.

meanings: A stance is an attitude about an issue that someone states clearly.
examples: My stance is that using oil and gas is bad for the environment.

meanings: A telegraph is a method of sending electric messages on wires.
examples: In the 1900s, the telegraph was the fastest way to send a message.

meanings: Textile is cloth that has been woven or knitted.
examples: The blue textile was going to be used to make blouses.

meanings: A tornado is a tube-shaped formation of air that spins very quickly.
examples: During a tornado , the safest place to be is underground.

meanings: A typhoon is a large tropical storm that moves in circles.
examples: Thousands of people lost electricity after a typhoon hit Australia.

words.general_translation_vi: Than van, than khóc, rền rĩ
meanings: To wail is to show sadness by crying loudly.
examples: The baby wailed because it was hungry.

meanings: A wardrobe is the collection of all of a person's clothing.
examples: She bought some new clothes to expand her wardrobe .
